description:
List recent Jules sessions with optional pagination.

Use this when an AI agent needs to discover recent sessions before selecting IDs for inspection or status checks.

Returns: { success: true, data: { sessions: [{ name, id, title, url, state?, createTime? }], nextPageToken? } }

See also: jules_monitor (status for known IDs), jules_interact (full session record)
name: jules_list_sessions
